reviewer_statement: Re-attested on 2026-09-24 against a corrected team-markets report, with the same twelve markets and the same decision. The measurement the 2026-09-23 receipt cited took the best price per wager across two snapshot windows and across face-off, and that flattered all three team markets. In the `late` window, strictly before face-off: moneyline -6.6% over 954 bets (was +0.0% over 1,366), puck line -4.2% over 1,117 (was -1.3% over 1,762), totals -4.0% over 1,216 (was -2.5% over 2,201). Every interval still includes zero, so no market's verdict changed, and neither does this decision. Two of the cited records are stale on the team markets and I approve knowing that: `what_we_can_claim.md` still quotes the pre-correction figures, and `allowlist_evidence_bundle.md` was generated before the full team purchase. For the team markets, `team_markets_measurement.md` is the record. The rest of the 2026-09-23 statement stands unchanged: approved against the measurement's own recommendation, and recorded that way on purpose. The evidence bundle assembled from these records supports enabling NOTHING: of the twelve markets, `points` is a demonstrated deficit (-4.4% over 6,202 bets, corrected interval excluding zero on the losing side, and it replicated as a loss on a second window); `blocked_shots` is the only positive that survived its discovery window and the held-out window did not confirm it (+4.5% over 2,950 bets, interval including zero); seven show no demonstrated edge; and `hits`, `regulation_3_way` and `team_total` have never been measured against real prices at all. Across the wider population the model's disagreement with the market carries a regression coefficient of 0.032 where the market carries 0.97, and a larger claimed edge is reliably worse. The 2026-08-27 approval of these same markets was withdrawn on 2026-08-29 when buying the full two-season population changed the sign; the only evidence that has moved since is the team correction above, and it moved in the direction of less support, not more. I am enabling them anyway, to run the card forward and accumulate a live record; this is a decision about what to do next, not a claim that the model has an edge, and the card's own reports continue to say it has none.
